130+ integrations available
Your CX AI stack, unified.
Pre‑built integrations, a self‑serve Connect Portal, and open APIs enable your AI agents to work seamlessly with all of your existing systems.
Explore integrationsRequest a demo
• Self serve integration
Up and running in minutes.
Our built-in Connect Portal gives you a fully whitelabelled integration experience. Authenticate, configure field mappings, and go live all without leaving Agent Studio.
Managed OAuth 2.0
Industry-standard secure authentication with automatic health-checks and token refresh.
Custom Field Mapping
Map your data your way with full support for custom objects, fields, and user-defined filters.
Built-In Monitoring
Real-time sync status, error tracking, and automatic retry are all visible from your dashboard.
Zero External Dependencies
Everything happens inside PolyAI with no need for third-party dashboards or external config portals.
• Integration catalog
Agent Studio provides pre-built integrations across four key categories:
TelephonyCRM and knowledgeProductivity and collaborationVertical systems
• Telephony and voice routing
• CRM and knowledge
• Productivity and collaboration
• Vertical systems
Platform extensibility
If it has an API, PolyAI connects to it.
Fancy coding yourself? No problem. Our Agent Developer Kit (ADK) gives you full programmatic control. Define custom functions, build conversation flows, and integrate with any enterprise system.
Explore ADK documentation
